# name|fen|depth|nodes
#
# The six standard perft positions from the Chess Programming Wiki. Each one is
# chosen to break a different part of move generation: kiwipete is dense with
# castling, pins and en passant; position 3 is a pawn/rook endgame full of
# en passant and promotion races; position 4 mixes promotions with castling
# rights; position 5 is a known trap for castling-rights bookkeeping; position 6
# is a quiet, wide middlegame that exercises sheer breadth.
#
# Records named "slow-" are skipped by default: together they count some 15
# million nodes, which takes minutes under ASan/UBSan. Set C3_SLOW_PERFT=1 to
# include them.
